The present petition seeks quashing of FIR No. 0062/2021 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC at P.S. Nihal Vihar and all proceedings emanating therefrom including the chargesheet pending before the Court of competent jurisdiction.
3. Learned APP for the State accepts notice.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter has amicably been settled between the parties before the Mediation Centre, District Courts, Gurugram and in pursuance thereof, decree of divorce has already been granted vide judgement dated 01.02.2023, passed by learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Gurugram, Haryana.
5. On the petitioner taking necessary steps, issue notice to respondent No. 2, through all permissible modes, including electronic mode, if any, returnable on 28.07.2023.
